story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. Brighton seafront: the pier and its shingle beach by the sea (kit place: beach); morning wind, afternoon, golden dusk
2. Grandfather's kitchen with a wooden table and a window (kit place: kitchen); morning light

On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier. A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner. Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest. Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper. At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread. Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind. Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember. In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm. Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves. She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy. At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.

bible.title: The Mended Kite
bible.logline: A torn kite, a sailor's seam, and a gold star mend more than fabric on a Brighton autumn day.

cast.name: Maya
cast.look: Eight-year-old girl, rounded soft shape, shoulder-length chestnut hair with a loose braid, yellow raincoat over striped sweater, navy trousers, red wellies. Signature detail: a small seashell pendant on a cord.

cast.name: Grandfather
cast.look: Elderly man, gentle stoop, silver-white hair brushed back, wire-rim spectacles, cream wool cardigan over checked shirt, charcoal trousers, leather slippers. Signature detail: a sailor's tattoo anchor on his forearm visible when sleeves roll up.

cast.name: Red Kite
cast.look: Diamond-shaped red sailcloth kite, bamboo spars, cotton bridle lines. Torn diagonally from corner to corner, patched with white sailcloth seam, small gold five-point star painted over the patch. Signature detail: the gold star catches light.

cast.name: Brighton Seafront
cast.look: Victorian pier with green-painted iron girders and wooden decking, shingle beach of smooth flint pebbles, low chalk cliffs behind, groynes stretching into the Channel. Morning wind ruffles the sea; golden dusk paints the water amber.

cast.name: Grandfather's Kitchen
cast.look: Compact 1890s kitchen, rustic vintage wooden table with turned legs and scarred top, bifold window with rustic wood frame opening to a small herb bar, cream-painted brick walls, copper kettle on a black range. Morning light slants across the table.

shots.description: Brighton seafront at morning wind: the pier stretches into a ruffled sea, shingle beach curves left. Maya stands on the deck, red kite soaring high above the railings, line taut in her small hands. Cool pale light, gulls wheeling.
shots.dialogue: On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier.

shots.description: Close on the pier railings: a sudden gust slams the kite sideways, the red sailcloth catches the green iron and tears cleanly from lower corner to upper corner. Maya's hands jerk; the line goes slack. Wind whips her braid.
shots.dialogue: A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner.

shots.description: Maya runs along the shingle beach toward the cliffs, the broken kite hugged tight to her chest, red sail folded over her raincoat. Pebbles clatter under her wellies. Morning light still pale, wind at her back.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest.

shots.description: Grandfather's kitchen, morning light slant of morning light: vintage wooden table by the bifold window. Grandfather sits in a high-backed chair, newspaper half-lowered, spectacles catching the light. He looks up as the door clicks shut.
shots.dialogue: Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper.

shots.description: Insert on the table: the red kite laid flat, torn seam exposed. Grandfather's weathered hands thread a needle with white sailcloth thread from a wooden spool. Copper kettle reflects the window. Rustic table grain visible.
shots.dialogue: At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread.

shots.description: Over Grandfather's shoulder: two-shot at the table. He guides the needle in a sailor's seam — tiny even stitches bridging the tear. Maya leans in, chin on fists, watching each stitch. Light warms toward noon.
shots.dialogue: Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind.

shots.description: Maya's fingers hold a small gold paint pot and a fine brush. She dabs a five-point star over the white patch; the gold catches the window light. Grandfather's hand rests nearby, approving.
shots.dialogue: Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember.

shots.description: Brighton seafront at afternoon: sun higher, sea brighter. Maya and Grandfather walk the shingle beach together, Grandfather carrying the mended kite under his arm, Maya skipping beside him. Pier shadows shorten.
shots.dialogue: In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm.

shots.description: Low angle on the beach: Maya runs into the onshore wind, paying out line. The red kite climbs steeply, gold star winking, higher than the pier railings, higher than the gulls. Grandfather stands back, line slack in his hand.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves.

shots.description: Two-shot at the water's edge: Maya holds the winding handle out to Grandfather. He takes it, head thrown back, laughing open-mouthed like a boy. The kite pulls strong above them. Afternoon light golden on their faces.
shots.dialogue: She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy.

shots.description: Golden dusk on the seafront: the sun sits on the horizon, sea amber, pier a silhouette. Maya and Grandfather walk the wet sand homeward, the mended kite resting on Maya's shoulder, gold star glowing. Long shadows, gentle tide.
shots.dialogue: At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.
